Shop My Account ​ ​ Much Ado About Nothing Directed by David Frederick Mold June 10-28, 2026 Pinkney Park, Rowayton, CT Join Shakespeare on the Sound as we celebrate 30 seasons of storytelling under the stars with Much Ado About Nothing .
​ Shakespeare’s sparkling comedy transports audiences to 19th‑century Sicily, where romance blooms, tempers flare, and a battle of wits becomes a battle of hearts.
​ Enjoy a brilliant ensemble bringing this “merry war” of words to life in one of Connecticut’s most beloved outdoor settings.
Come laugh, love, and experience why Shakespeare’s language still dazzles.
It’s the perfect summer night out!
​ ​ ​ VIP TICKETS PRE-SALE from April 7-14.
GENERAL ADMISSION TICKETS on sale beginning April 15.

​ GET TICKETS Written by William Shakespeare Directed by David Frederick Mold Choreographer: Haila Strauss Stage Manager: Lauren Nicole Jackson Assistant Stage Manager: Abba Wilson Set Design: Brian Prather Lighting Design: Jamie Roderick Costume Design: Grier Coleman Sound Design/Composer: Chad Rains Audio 1: Destiny Scott Audio 2: Nicholas Moran Wardrobe Supervisor: Rileigh Erickson Technical Director: Maia Robbins-Zust June 10-28th (except Mondays) June 16 and 23th at 7:30pm on Tuesdays are Pay-What-You-Will Shakespeare Suggested donation amounts are $25 for adults, and $5 for children 12 and under.
Reserve your ticket online or at the box office in the p ark day-of.

​ June 10-28th at 7:30pm on evenings Wednesdays through Sundays General Admission General admission tickets to our shows June 12-30th on Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday evenings are $25 for adults, $5 children 12 and under.

​ June 20 at 1pm - Apprentice Company Matinee Performance is Pay-What-You-Will Shakespeare Enjoy Shakespeare on the Sound's Apprentice Company in their "Understudy run" which is open to the general public.
Come cheer on and support the next generation of theater makers!
​ VIP Reserved seating to our shows any day of the week is $75.
Please take a look at our Reserved VIP Seating page to l earn more!
​ Student and Senior rush seating is $15.
These tickets are available to seniors over 65 and current students and sold in person only at the box office in the p ark day-of.
​ SPECIAL EVENTS ​ Opening Night Pre-show Reception 6-7:30pm on Saturday, June 13.
Come celebrate the Opening Night!
Light bites, beer, wine, soda included.
$50 with the purchase of your Main Stage performance ticket.
​ SOS Book Club - Thursday, June 18.
(Thursday, June 25th rain date) Join Director of Education and Outreach Stephanie Eiss and educator and former Board President John Love for a guided discussion about the play.
$25 with the purchase of your Main Stage performance ticket.
​ ​ ​ Alumni Night Reception.
Pre-show from 6-7:30pm on Saturday, June 20th.
Raise a glass to 30 years!
Anyone who has worked with SOS as a volunteer, board, cast, crew, or die-hard supporter is invited to attend.
Light bites, beer, wine, soda included.
$50 with the purchase of your Main Stage performance ticket.
​ ​ ​ ​ *No shows Mondays *Park opens at 5pm for blankets and chairs.
​ *In the event of inclement weather, the start of the performance may be delayed; however, the performance will begin as soon as it is possible to do so.
Performances may also pause for sudden changes in weather, but will resume as soon as weather permits.
We will only cancel in extreme weather conditions, and will post alerts on our website and on social media with as much notice as possible.
